title: How AI Responses Shape User Beliefs: The Effects of Information Detail and Confidence on Belief Strength and Stance
reasoning: The paper investigates the psychological and behavioral mechanisms of how AI response characteristics influence user belief change. While it includes a discussion section on 'Ethical Concern for Malicious Uses' regarding manipulation and autonomy, this is an analysis of the study's implications rather than a central evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
